checks.evidence: 4 cases PASS; production main and OpenAI compatible HTTP/SSE provider; 3 nonempty bubbles; 5 requests; read/write approval allow+deny; local deterministic model only

sourceReview.senderSessionBoundary: Cancel finds existing binding with JSON channel/sender key; status and cancel both target exactly that session; foreign sender has no binding and cannot invoke owner cancellation. Approval ownership remains untouched.
sourceReview.cancelRaces: actor.cancelTurn checks exact active turn id. Status/cancel interleaving can safely return not_running but cannot cancel a successor by mistake. Existing direct-send starting fallback retained. Actor-generated follow-up starting has no activeTurn/status visibility and cache can still name predecessor; this narrow existing window is not claimed fixed.
sourceReview.emptyAssistant: Only appendAssistantText returns on empty string; tool result/history rendering and tool/approval event handling stay independent. Nonempty assistant IDs and rendering are unchanged. Production server sends complete assistant records, no per-token events on trail.
sourceReview.regressionReality: Added tests use real createRuntimeRpc/Gateway with genuine active SessionActor, and real HTTP+production Harness composition for durable session data. Model response is deterministic, not a model-quality benchmark.

remainingGate: Existing candidate 27 browser cases and independent extra 10 controls not yet final-reviewed. Extra initial run failed 8/10; preserve raw results and inspect corrected probe rather than override failure.
limitations: No paid external model calls or quality claim.
HTTP 200 means command/message received, not durable task completion.
Session bindings remain process-local; restart recovery not improved.
Stop cancels current running turn, not all queued future turns; no atomic stop-all semantics added.
